questions.question: What question did the people bring to the priests and prophets in Zechariah 7?
options: Whether they should now go to war against all of their enemies
Whether they should hurry to rebuild all of the broken-down city walls
Whether they should crown for themselves a brand new king
Whether they should keep mourning and fasting as they had for years
questions.answer: Whether they should keep mourning and fasting as they had for years

questions.question: What did God say he had truly required, rather than mere fasting?
options: To raise up a temple far grander than the one of Solomon long before
To keep yet many more days of very solemn fasting all throughout the whole year
To bring still far more and far richer sacrifices to the altar of God
To render true judgments, show kindness and mercy, and not oppress the weak
questions.answer: To render true judgments, show kindness and mercy, and not oppress the weak

questions.question: Zechariah 7 recalls that the people's fathers refused to listen and made their hearts hard as flint.
Administer true justice; show loving devotion and _____ to one another.
Do not oppress the widow, the fatherless, the sojourner, or the _____.
